nodes.summary: Empirical AUC = Mann–Whitney with ties (Bamber 1975): the trapezoidal area under the empirical ROC curve equals `U / (m n)`, for nonempty samples.
nodes.title: Empirical AUC = Mann–Whitney with ties

nodes.summary: Trapezoidal area under the empirical ROC curve of positive scores `x` and negative scores `y`: the sum over the distinct observed scores `t` of the trapezoid from the point `(rocRateAbove y t, rocRateAbove x t)` to `(rocRate y t, rocRate x t)`.
nodes.title: Empirical area under the ROC curve

nodes.summary: Mann–Whitney count `U = ∑ᵢ ∑ⱼ (1[y j < x i] + ½ 1[y j = x i])` of (positive, negative) pairs ranked correctly, with ties counted one half.
nodes.title: Mann–Whitney U statistic

nodes.summary: If no score lies strictly between `t < t'`, the strict rate at `t` is the rate at `t'`: the left end of the trapezoid at `t` is the ROC point of the next larger distinct score.
nodes.title: Strict ROC rate equals the rate at the next score

nodes.summary: Above the largest score the strict rate is zero: the first trapezoid starts at `(0, 0)`.
nodes.title: Strict ROC rate vanishes above the largest score

nodes.summary: Empirical rate `#{i | t < z i} / k` of scores strictly above `t`: the ROC coordinate at the next larger distinct score.
nodes.title: Empirical ROC rate strictly above a threshold

nodes.summary: Empirical rate `#{i | t ≤ z i} / k` of scores at or above the threshold `t` (the true- or false-positive rate when `z` are the positive or negative scores).
nodes.title: Empirical ROC rate at or above a threshold

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
